summary: BetterLife Pharma Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with exhibits comprising a Notice of Annual General Meeting and Information Circular dated September 14, 2026, plus a form of proxy and notice-and-access materials. The virtual AGM is set for October 14, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific via conference call. Shareholders will receive fiscal 2026 and 2025 financial statements and vote on setting board size, electing directors, reappointing MNP LLP as auditor, and approving an amended and restated 2026 long-term incentive plan. No special-situation transaction, pricing, or board recommendation on a deal is present.
